answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the forge index resolves every citation against the marble checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the lantern audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 2822 identities would post 2960 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
